about: Which Kyr definitions represent each Orsino registry entry, and how far. support: represented (typed Kyr equivalent, some mechanics omitted), executable (every source mechanic runs through canonical Kyr systems or has a declared adaptation), play-validated (exercised in real play; evidence is file#text that must appear in that file). Every feature Kyr judges unsupported must be listed under omits or adapts. Checked by test/orsino-registry.test.ts.

Stat line, stat base, terrain, aspect and type overlays and hit points are composed by OrsinoMonsters exactly as the monster template computes them (red, Dragon type, wildtype, mountain, minor rank, level 1): Str 35, Dex 28, Con 32, Int 29, Wis 27, Cha 31, 99 HP. Kyr's statMod reads those scores.

omits.field:monsterNaturalArmor: Scale armour gives Orsino AC 4; Kyr has no armour class yet.
omits.field:monsterAttacksPerTurn: Orsino dragons attack three times a turn; a Kyr creature acts once per turn.
omits.field:monsterGold: The 10d100 gold hoard is not placed; the lair holds only authored items.
omits.field:monsterTraits: Partly. Formidable is a passive trait (without its toHit). Flying is not attached: its only effects, evasion and toHit, have no Kyr meaning yet.
omits.field:monsterAbilities: Partly. Melee with the colour's breath weapon becomes orsino_fire_breath. Maul (slow's attribute, initiative and extra-attack penalties; dice-based bleeding) and flight (an arcane spell) are not given.

records.note: The type's attribute overlay (+6 Str, +4 Dex, +5 Con, +4 Int, +3 Wis, +5 Cha) is part of the composed stat line.

omits.field:monsterTypeAbilities: Flight and maul are not given; see monsterClass:dragon.

records.note: The red colour's fire_breath replaces the bite, as the template's overlay does. Its description is the kind's description.

Exact 4d6 fire. Orsino fires it at one target through melee with an attack roll and no save. Kyr breathes it over every opponent with one shared roll, a breath-category save (Orsino's Constitution-based category, its modifiers and immunity) against 15 + the dragon's level (Orsino's default debuff difficulty) for half, and a three-turn recharge. Fire released this way exposes the place to fire.

Exact 1d6 piercing plus the attacker's positive strength modifier, as Orsino's melee damage bonus adds. The dragon bites while its breath rekindles: a Kyr adaptation, since Orsino's coloured dragons carry their breath weapon instead. Accuracy is a Kyr typed attack against 10, not THAC0 against armour class.

Translated by OrsinoStatuses: +2 will saves, 10% bludgeoning, piercing and slashing resistance, bonusDamage 3 as Kyr power. The resistances apply to those typed subtypes; legacy untyped physical damage is not resisted.
